body: S3 #4362 five post-cap P2s pushed at f037b9d2878, one commit, these five only: (1) unterminated final journal line = uncommitted even if it parses; flush re-appends, append cuts only that tail (regression: short final write). (2) reruns_done per run: recorded only on an accepted request; failed/deadline-skipped retried, accepted never repeated (regression). (3) busy watch lock during note_smoke_failure -> spool file .aida/land/main-watch-smoke.spool, replayed next pass; dev build error reports it (SmokeNote). (4) github_run_jobs paginates with completeness checks, used by run_job_report and github_run_job_failed_steps (regression: failed job on page 2; incomplete listing refused). (5) close "fixed" only when the fix spec completed or a closing commit names it; else "unattributed" (regressions). main_watch 49/49, commit_ci 25/25, dev_build 105/105, completion seam 14/14, check-ci-fast exit 0; ci:full relabelled.
